title: Coding Challenge 6: WebSocket Connection
description:
Learn how to establish real-time, bidirectional communication using the native browser WebSocket API. Unlike HTTP requests which follow a single request-response cycle and close, a WebSocket creates a persistent connection where client and server can send messages to each other at any time.

In this challenge, you will connect to the public WebSocket echo service ('wss://echo.websocket.org') which reflects back any text message it receives.

You will implement three progressive functions using standard callbacks:
1. connectWebSocket(url, onOpen): Creates a new WebSocket connection to 'url' and invokes onOpen(socket) as soon as the connection is open.
2. listenForMessages(socket, onMessage): Listens for incoming messages on 'socket' and invokes onMessage(event.data) with the message text.
3. sendEcho(message, onEcho): Connects to 'wss://echo.websocket.org', sends 'message' once connected, calls onEcho(event.data) when the echoed response arrives, and closes the socket.
requirements: 'connectWebSocket(url, onOpen)' must instantiate and return a 'new WebSocket(url)'
'connectWebSocket(url, onOpen)' must invoke 'onOpen(socket)' when the connection is opened ('open' event)
'listenForMessages(socket, onMessage)' must listen for incoming messages and pass 'event.data' to 'onMessage'
'sendEcho(message, onEcho)' must connect to 'wss://echo.websocket.org' and return the socket instance
'sendEcho(message, onEcho)' must send 'message' once connected and invoke 'onEcho(event.data)' with the reply
'sendEcho(message, onEcho)' must close the socket connection after receiving the echo
hints: To create a WebSocket: 'const socket = new WebSocket(url);'
To listen for the connection opening: use 'socket.addEventListener("open", () => onOpen(socket))' or 'socket.onopen = () => onOpen(socket)'
To listen for incoming messages: use 'socket.addEventListener("message", (event) => onMessage(event.data))' or 'socket.onmessage = (event) => onMessage(event.data)'
In sendEcho, wait for the 'open' event before calling 'socket.send(message)' so the connection is ready
In sendEcho, when the echo arrives, pass 'event.data' to 'onEcho(event.data)' and call 'socket.close()' to cleanly disconnect

tests.name: connectWebSocket returns a WebSocket instance
tests.test: function() { try { if (typeof connectWebSocket !== 'function') { return { success: false, message: 'connectWebSocket function does not exist' }; } const s = connectWebSocket('wss://echo.websocket.org', () => {}); if (!s || !(s instanceof WebSocket)) { return { success: false, message: 'connectWebSocket must return a WebSocket instance' }; } s.close(); return { success: true }; } catch (e) { return { success: false, message: e.message }; } }
tests.successMessage: connectWebSocket returns a valid WebSocket instance ✓

tests.name: connectWebSocket invokes onOpen when connected
tests.test: async function() { if (typeof connectWebSocket !== 'function') { return { success: false, message: 'connectWebSocket is not defined' }; } return new Promise((resolve) => { let socket = null; const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (socket) try { socket.close(); } catch(_) {} resolve({ success: false, message: 'Timed out waiting for onOpen callback to fire' }); }, 5000); try { socket = connectWebSocket('wss://echo.websocket.org', (connectedSocket) => { clearTimeout(timer); if (!connectedSocket || !(connectedSocket instanceof WebSocket)) { if (socket) try { socket.close(); } catch(_) {} return resolve({ success: false, message: 'onOpen callback should receive the WebSocket instance' }); } if (connectedSocket.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) { connectedSocket.close(); return resolve({ success: false, message: 'WebSocket should be in OPEN state (1) when onOpen is called, got: ' + connectedSocket.readyState }); } connectedSocket.close(); resolve({ success: true }); }); } catch (e) { clearTimeout(timer); resolve({ success: false, message: e.message }); } }); }
tests.successMessage: connectWebSocket successfully notifies onOpen when connection is ready ✓

tests.name: listenForMessages extracts and passes event.data
tests.test: function() { try { if (typeof listenForMessages !== 'function') { return { success: false, message: 'listenForMessages function does not exist' }; } let received = null; const mockSocket = new EventTarget(); mockSocket.onmessage = null; listenForMessages(mockSocket, (data) => { received = data; }); const testPayload = 'hello-payload-' + Date.now(); const event = new MessageEvent('message', { data: testPayload }); if (typeof mockSocket.onmessage === 'function') { mockSocket.onmessage(event); } else { mockSocket.dispatchEvent(event); } if (received !== testPayload) { if (typeof received === 'object' && received !== null) { return { success: false, message: 'You passed the event object to onMessage. Pass event.data instead!' }; } return { success: false, message: 'listenForMessages must pass event.data to callback. Received: ' + JSON.stringify(received) }; } return { success: true }; } catch (e) { return { success: false, message: e.message }; } }
tests.successMessage: listenForMessages correctly extracts and passes event.data ✓

tests.name: sendEcho sends message and receives echoed text
tests.test: async function() { if (typeof sendEcho !== 'function') { return { success: false, message: 'sendEcho function does not exist' }; } return new Promise((resolve) => { const testMsg = 'EchoTest_' + Math.floor(Math.random() * 10000); let socket = null; const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (socket) try { socket.close(); } catch(_) {} resolve({ success: false, message: 'Timed out waiting for echoed response from server' }); }, 5000); try { socket = sendEcho(testMsg, (reply) => { clearTimeout(timer); if (reply !== testMsg) { if (typeof reply === 'object' && reply !== null) { return resolve({ success: false, message: 'You passed the event object to onEcho. Pass event.data instead!' }); } return resolve({ success: false, message: 'Expected echo reply "' + testMsg + '", got: "' + reply + '"' }); } resolve({ success: true }); }); } catch (e) { clearTimeout(timer); resolve({ success: false, message: e.message }); } }); }
tests.successMessage: sendEcho successfully sends and receives echoed message ✓

tests.name: sendEcho cleanly closes socket after receiving echo
tests.test: async function() { if (typeof sendEcho !== 'function') { return { success: false, message: 'sendEcho function does not exist' }; } return new Promise((resolve) => { let socket = null; const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (socket) try { socket.close(); } catch(_) {} resolve({ success: false, message: 'Timed out waiting for sendEcho' }); }, 5000); try { socket = sendEcho('closeCheck', (reply) => { clearTimeout(timer); setTimeout(() => { if (!socket) { return resolve({ success: false, message: 'sendEcho should return the created socket instance' }); } const state = socket.readyState; if (state !== WebSocket.CLOSING && state !== WebSocket.CLOSED) { return resolve({ success: false, message: 'Expected socket to be closed after echo, but readyState is ' + state }); } resolve({ success: true }); }, 50); }); } catch (e) { clearTimeout(timer); resolve({ success: false, message: e.message }); } }); }
tests.successMessage: sendEcho cleanly closes the WebSocket connection after receiving echo ✓
